turns.query: Identify the air quality monitoring station that recorded the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025. What was the average recorded traffic speed across all road segments within 500 meters of this station at that exact same time (rounded to 1 decimal place)?
turns.actual_response:
The air quality monitoring station that recorded the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025, was **Causeway Bay** (Station ID: 17) with a concentration of **35.7 µg/m³**.

The average recorded traffic speed across all 84 road segments within 500 meters of this station at that exact time was **53.3 km/h**.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query 1: PM10 concentrations and coordinates for all monitoring stations at 14:00:00 on 2025-10-05
pm10_query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.id as station_id,
    aqs.name_en as station_name,
    aqs.coordinate as station_coordinate,
    hsaq.pm10,
    hsaq.datetime
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
ORDER BY aqs.id
""")

pm10_df = pd.read_sql(pm10_query, engine)
pm10_df['station_coordinate'] = pm10_df['station_coordinate'].apply(lambda x: x.coords[0] if x else None)
pm10_df['longitude'] = pm10_df['station_coordinate'].apply(lambda x: x[0] if x else None)
pm10_df['latitude'] = pm10_df['station_coordinate'].apply(lambda x: x[1] if x else None)
pm10_df = pm10_df.drop(columns=['station_coordinate'])
print(f"PM10 records found: {len(pm10_df)}")
print(pm10_df.to_string())

""")

traffic_df = pd.read_sql(traffic_query, engine)

WHERE ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography,

""")
